duplicate_context_comparisons.context_applicability: Same June 2026 column and same 211 symbol-limit pairs; CRLF-only difference has no cell-level effect. Prior position-limit context applies, without current regulatory verification.
duplicate_context_comparisons.prior_evidence_limit: Prior regulatory links and fopl ratios were not independently reopened or recomputed; only MPL bytes and all CSV cells were freshly compared.

findings.finding: All 1200 rows are DATA_NEEDED. B01-B20 contain 1000 generic block-plus-template names; B21-B24 contain 200 more specific labels. No observation values, dedicated unit/scale contracts, computation definitions, thresholds, calibration dates, per-row sources or resolved data types are supplied. Some labels do express percentages; those labels are not a complete unit contract.
findings.consequence: A research and implementation inventory is present; 1200 evaluated runtime signals are not demonstrated. Preserve the declared source-priority string as a claim, not a verified provider hierarchy.

findings.finding: The application static framework names disagree with CSV block meanings for B04 through B21, 18 of 24 blocks. For example B04 is Collapse Drivers in the CSV and Valuation and Re-rating in code; B15 is Supply Chain in the CSV and Delivery and Volume in code. All 1200 source IDs P0001-P1200 differ from the 175 runtime catalog IDs.
findings.consequence: Block number or parameter ordinal cannot be used as an automatic mapping. Four B02 dashboard source labels cite this dictionary but their 1M/3M/6M/12M return definitions do not appear in its corresponding ordinal rows. This audit does not select which specification should govern.

findings.finding: 898 types are the ambiguous numeric/text/date union. Some numeric labels such as Price source (P1158), Parameter version (P1186), Commercial use allowed (P1194) and Redistribution allowed (P1195) require explicit semantic contracts before coercion. Three name pairs repeat across equity and commodity blocks while all IDs are unique.
findings.consequence: No automatic type coercion, name-only deduplication or activation is justified. The source explicitly says not to delete entries and to mark duplicate/merged if replaced.

findings.finding: Internals contain 2477 dates from 2016-02-02 to 2026-06-08 and n_symbols=13 on every row; every status says SAMPLE_16_STOCKS_NOT_MARKET_WIDE. The industry table describes 16 distinct historical symbols in nine groups, not 16 simultaneous daily constituents. The series has a 128-calendar-day gap from 2021-02-01 to 2021-06-09; the latter row stores a 0.1637766529929463 one-day return label.
findings.consequence: These are dated pilot aggregates, not complete market breadth or verified continuous session windows. Accepted duplicate context documents membership changes and observation-gap effects; this audit does not reopen the 32201-row underlying table or independently recertify those calculations.

findings.finding: 800 fields are empty. The 781 missing tail-repair ratios decompose into five missing-tail rows and 776 zero-denominator rows. On 2019-01-28 and 2020-04-13 both average delivery percentage and delivery HHI are blank while saved total delivery quantity is zero. Initial unavailable tails coexist with zero research flags.
findings.consequence: A saved aggregate zero or binary zero cannot be read as observed zero delivery or verified absence of risk. No blanks or saved zeros were replaced.

findings.finding: All q90/q95 flags reproduce using inclusive full-sample tail thresholds 0.38461538461538464 and 0.5384615384615384; all trailing-10 five-fire cluster flags and all filled tail-repair ratios reproduce. The CSV supplies no producer code, fit timestamp or training-only threshold contract.
findings.consequence: This reconstruction is arithmetic consistency, not recovered producer intent or proof of point-in-time validity; possible future-information leakage remains unresolved.

findings.finding: 211 unique symbols have positive integer June 2026 MWPL limits between 736885 and 12096038468. The file contains no current positions, actual institutional trades or row-level effective dates. Exact CSV cells match the accepted bhavcopy copy, with CRLF versus LF accounting for all 212 differing bytes.
findings.consequence: Retain the monthly period and position-limit meaning. These numbers do not establish actual ownership, net purchases, a ranking score, current limits or regulatory completeness; no current external authority check was made.

findings.finding: Every source CSV cell was consumed and independently matched. Primary keys have zero duplicates and rows have zero width errors. Two copies match accepted evidence byte-for-byte and the MWPL copy matches cell-for-cell after newline decoding.
findings.consequence: Exactly four member-level content-coverage upgrades may be proposed. This does not complete the AM07 archive or promote any runtime authority.

consumer_inspection.observed: Imports and applies applyDataIntelligencePatches during source construction; inspected statically only.

Hardcodes a 1200-parameter framework and names the CSV as source, with 24 hardcoded blocks. It does not parse the CSV. Compare all block names in parameter_dictionary.runtime_framework_name_comparison.

B02_P006-B02_P009 have hardcoded momentum labels and cite parameters_v0_7 B02. Source ordinals contain generic risk/opportunity/quality/velocity labels, with no thresholds or 21/63/126/252-day formulas.

Loads the separate 175-entry JSON catalog. Momentum branches use candle returns; B15_P016 uses last-20 OHLCV volume buckets and at least 21 candles. These do not consume mini-market aggregate CSV records.
NO07 delivery spike requires own-60D percentile80 and positive CLV, with NSE_DELIVERY_FEED_REQUIRED readiness. Aggregate sample delivery or breadth is not that stock-level contract.
DELIVERY_20 reads a 20-day delivery percentile and positive return condition. A supplied fpiCategoryTotalPctMwpl emits FPI_MWPL_PROFILE_UNVALIDATED annotation.
fpiMwpl uses audit_annotation_only, scoreWeightPct 0 and deterministic_ratio_not_rank_eligible. Saved MWPL limits alone cannot supply actual FPI activity.

limits: Only the four listed AM07 members received new full-content review. Other AM07 members gain no coverage here.
reviewed means complete serialized-content inspection, not source authority, economic correctness, currentness, feed readiness, validated strategy edge or activation.

Comparisons reopen only the three matching members of the accepted delivery and bhavcopy archives. Underlying delivery rows, original producer code, current exchange rules and current provider identities were not newly verified.
The industry CSV provides no classification authority or effective date. MWPL provides a month in its header but no daily validity stamp or unit definition beyond the label.
Artifact Tool CSV import was read only; no spreadsheet export, formula activation, source repair, numerical coercion or source normalization was saved.
Bounded static consumer inspection is not a live call-path or deployed-service test; no server, application suite, provider request, Mongo query, trade or deployment was run.
Coverage overlay and phase plan were not edited. Four member transitions are proposals pending integration and independent acceptance.
Archive source and comparison copies remain intact; exact and semantic duplicates are reported without deletion or preferred-source selection.

units.trade_date: ISO date, observed records not an independently verified exchange calendar
units.total_delivery_qty: aggregate deliverable quantity; saved zeros on missing-delivery dates require caution
units.total_turnover: rupees inherited from accepted duplicate upstream-context evidence; unit not explicit in this CSV header
units.volume_hhi: sum of squared quantity shares (fraction scale)
units.delivery_hhi: sum of squared delivery quantity shares (fraction scale)
units.tail_repair_ratio_5d: dimensionless ratio, blank for missing or zero denominator
units.sample_flags: binary research flags, original threshold training/timing contract absent

mwpl.role: Saved market-wide position limits; no actual positions, ownership or institutional-flow measurements
